runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs
runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here after a Refresh.

ciTab.heading: CI deployment
ciTab.emptyBody: Export this agent to GitHub Actions to review every pull request automatically.
ciTab.noRecentRuns: No runs recorded yet. Press Refresh after a pull request has been reviewed in CI.

failOn.label: Fail CI on
failOn.hint: Baked into the exported manifest — re-export to apply a change in CI.

target.unsupportedProvider: Only agents using the OpenRouter provider can run in CI. Change this agent’s provider to OpenRouter in the Config tab.

preview.runnerNote: Bundled DevDigest runner — committed as-is, not editable.

configure.secretOpenrouter: Your OpenRouter key — same BYO key from L06
configure.secretsHint: Add these to your repo’s Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
configure.blockMerge: To block merges: set Fail CI on (CI tab) so the run exits non-zero, then add a required status check in the repo’s GitHub branch protection. No GitHub App needed.

installStep.prTitle: Open a PR with these files
installStep.prBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
installStep.switchToZip: Copy files as a zip instead
installStep.tokenHint: Opening a PR needs a GitHub token with write access to this repository (fine-grained: Contents and Workflows → Read and write; classic: repo + workflow). Update it in Settings, or use the zip.

success.prBody: Merge the PR in {repo} to turn the workflow on.
success.zipBody: Unzip it into the root of {repo}, then commit and push to turn the workflow on.
success.secretReminder: Add {key} to the repo’s Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
